# npm-integration tests that still fall back to QuickJS on main. CI runs these with
# THAW_JS_FALLBACK=warn; every other registry_add test runs with THAW_JS_FALLBACK=error,
# so a fallback there fails the test.
#
# Shrink only. Delete a line when its test stops falling back (the job summary lists
# such tests). Never add a line: a PR that adds one fails CI, so fix the test instead.
# One test function name per line, without the tests:: prefix. Sorted.
registry_add_exposes_real_undici_named_exports_when_enabled
